Hi Susan — thanks for the clarity. Attached is a first-pass MAP (MAP_OneHealth_v2.xlsx) and a short smoke plan PDF embedded in the sheet. Key highlights from our side:

1) Success Milestones (must-pass to sign):
   - Quality: on OneHealth holdout set, response-level fidelity: average embedding cosine similarity >= 0.86 and top-1 rerank precision >= 92% on labeled subset.
   - Performance: sustained 50 qps (batching enabled) with p95 <= 350ms for 1k token requests during peak profile.
   - Cost: tokenized cost <= $1.20 per 1k generated tokens under the chosen quantization profile.
   - Security: data-in-transit and at-rest validated via our SOC2 evidence bundle; no customer PII persists beyond request lifetime; KV cache TTL < 30s for eval mode.

2) Exit gates (hard):
   - All three of Quality, Performance, and Security must meet targets in the two-week smoke window.
   - If Performance target misses by >20% on p95, we trigger fallback plan (smaller batch, region failover) and a one-week remediation sprint.

3) Acceptance smoke tests (to run across 10k representative requests):
   - Run A: Baseline (Redwood default model/quant) x 2k requests — collect latency/cost and correctness metrics.
   - Run B: Production profile (OneHealth sampling distribution, batching on) x 8k requests — collect p50/p95/p99, token cost, and embedding sim stats.
   - Regression checks: 20 labeled prompts to validate non-regression on safety and hallucination thresholds.

4) Ownership & timeline:
   - Redwood: provide test harness, pre-configured dockerized runner for local replay, and a shared dashboard (Drive link attached) for test artifacts and traces.
   - OneHealth: provide sanitized dataset and point-of-contact for test execution.
   - Target smoke window: May 11–24 (two full weeks).

5) Procurement note: if MAP conditions are met, Dedicated capacity provisioning lead time is ~3 business days after contract countersign. Procurement timeline file attached (onehealth-procurement-timeline.pdf) per your request.

Action items:
- Susan: confirm dataset cadence and final POC (who will run the replay).
- Marissa: can you add acceptance test owners & the runbook steps to the MAP sheet?
- Karthik: can you confirm provisioning lead time and any SLA addendum wording we should pre-stage?

Thanks — attaching the two files now.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
